plugins.name: codex-computer-use
plugins.description: Control native Mac apps through Codex, with per-app approval and /codex-cu on|off.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Makes the main session a lead that delegates to five specialist subagents: code-reader and research on Haiku; designer and developer on Sonnet; architect on Opus. The developer runs and reports its tests; the architect independently audits acceptance. With the jevKey option set (a TypeSafe key), Jev sizes only each call's effort, bounded to medium or high; models stay at role defaults or fixed twin ids, and any Jev request or config failure requests medium unless the agent has already sent its first step; that sends a redacted, truncated prompt to api.typesafe.ai. When ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is a gateway other than Anthropic's API, each role also gets a fixed-model crew:<role>-codex twin. With the codexLogin option, crew:code-reader-codex runs on your Codex CLI login with no gateway, its requests sent by crew to chatgpt.com's Codex backend; with the crew Codex helper installed, crew:developer-codex and crew:architect-codex run there too, inside codex app-server's own sandbox. In the codex crew mode (the mode option, or /crew-mode for one session), a plain crew:<role> call runs on its registered twin; what those subagents read and write goes to OpenAI through the gateway. An always-visible HUD band above the prompt shows plan progress and running agents.

plugins.name: tailscale
plugins.description: Read or change your tailnet through the Tailscale API using the apiKey plugin option.
